Kristen advises VedaBio on regulatory, clinical and quality strategy, bringing more than 15 years of experience developing and executing clinical and regulatory programs for infectious disease in vitro diagnostics. She previously served as VedaBio's VP of Regulatory, Clinical and Quality.
